root_binding_schema.accepted_utc: Root records actual acceptance UTC here after completion; this is a schema example, not actual acceptance
root_binding_schema.generation_receipt_sha256: Root supplies actual complete generation RECEIPT SHA
root_binding_schema.scoring_receipt_sha256: Root supplies actual complete scoring RECEIPT SHA

root_binding_meaning: Root binding of already accepted complete generation and scoring, not a new experiment or an additional independent result. Exporter refuses absent/unaccepted binding and verifies both exact receipt identities before any display/reference array reads.

overview.labels: Chinese/English target and role labels outside each tile; top caption states historical RGB/predicted geometry and checkerboard is no support, not GT visibility.

native_outputs.pixel_integrity: Native method/reference RGB bytes unchanged; labels in filenames, PNG iTXt Description and IMAGE_INDEX, with burned-in labels only outside native tiles in overview.

display_rules.methods_reference: Use already emitted uint8 NHWC from accepted generation/scoring; do not decode raw predictions or rerun quantizer.
display_rules.warp: Generation saved float32 [4,3,576,576] -> NHWC; verify finite RGB01 and zero-fill holes. Display uint8=floor(float64(RGB)*255+.5); preserve separate zero-hole version.
display_rules.holes: Only mask-false display-copy pixels replaced by 16px gray checkerboard184/224; supported pixels unchanged.
display_rules.mask: Generation saved bool[4,1,576,576] -> native L8,white255 support/black0 hole.
display_rules.scientific_meaning: Warp has real historical colors placed by predicted geometry, not target capture/new generation. Mask is predicted support, not confidence, correctness or physical visibility.

read_boundary: Only accepted generation/scoring JSON, four emitted uint8 arrays, generation warp_rgb01/image_mask and fixed S70 transformed reference; no running arrays, original RGB, depth, models, weights, credentials or AI generation. Font bytes are a display resource.
readback: Every written PNG reopened with Pillow: mode,size,all pixel bytes exact; save file bytes/SHA and pixel SHA. Pixel readback is distinct from root visual QA.

limits.enforcement: SIGALRM time; sampled self RSS/output, not kernel hard caps

failure: Unique visuals_01 mkdir; preserve partial outputs/error receipt, no overwrite or automatic retries.
preparation_checks: AST parse only. No exporter/import/image loading/array read performed; font byte hash recorded.
